stemMarkdown: Pipe A can fill a cistern in 15 hours and pipe B can fill it in 19 hours. If both pipes are opened together, how long will they take to fill the cistern? (2 decimal places, in hours.)
solutionMarkdown: A's rate $= 1/15$ of the cistern per hour, B's rate $= 1/19$. Combined rate $= 1/15 + 1/19 = 0.1193$ per hour. Time together $= \dfrac{1}{1/15+1/19} = 8.38$ hours.
